title: National Park Visits Set A Record, Then Fell 8.9 Million
hook: A record attendance year was immediately reversed by a shutdown.
closing: Even a one-year drop affects gateway businesses, staffing, and the visits families planned.
question: Which park would you visit?

segments.say: National park visits reached 331.9 million, setting a new attendance record.
National park visits fell to 323 million. A shutdown year immediately erased the record.
Blue Ridge Parkway still drew 16.5 million visits. Famous sites kept attracting crowds despite the broader decline.
